# NEW 2026-11-23 v21.0 Module E2: Scripted Triggers for Mid/Late-Game Disasters & Competitive AI Great-Power Resilience (oe_dis2_, 0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v210_disasters_ai.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope. True when a human player snowballs past Tier-1 hegemonic threshold.
oe_dis2_player_snowball_t1 = {
	is_ai = no
	is_rebel_country = no
	is_subject = no
	OR = {
		AND = {
			current_age = age_2_renaissance
			num_locations >= 140
		}
		AND = {
			current_age = age_3_discovery
			num_locations >= 220
		}
		AND = {
			current_age_or_later = { age = age_4_reformation }
			num_locations >= 320
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. True when a human player crosses Tier-2 transcontinental colossus threshold.
oe_dis2_player_snowball_t2 = {
	is_ai = no
	is_rebel_country = no
	is_subject = no
	OR = {
		AND = {
			current_age = age_2_renaissance
			num_locations >= 240
		}
		AND = {
			current_age = age_3_discovery
			num_locations >= 360
		}
		AND = {
			current_age_or_later = { age = age_4_reformation }
			num_locations >= 480
		}
	}
}

# Global/any scope. True if any human player currently meets Tier-1 or Tier-2 threshold.
oe_dis2_world_has_player_t1 = {
	any_country = {
		oe_dis2_player_snowball_t1 = yes
	}
}

oe_dis2_world_has_player_t2 = {
	any_country = {
		oe_dis2_player_snowball_t2 = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. Eligible AI Great Power to receive non-cheating resilience (STRICTLY is_ai = yes).
oe_dis2_ai_gp_candidate = {
	is_ai = yes
	is_rebel_country = no
	is_subject = no
	num_locations >= 40
	OR = {
		is_great_power = yes
		AND = {
			oe_dis2_is_historic_rival_pole = yes
			num_locations >= 60
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. True if any of the 4 political/social/colonial/confessional oe_dis2 disasters is active.
oe_dis2_has_conciliation_disaster = {
	OR = {
		has_active_disaster = disaster_type:oe_dis2_colonial_independence_wave
		has_active_disaster = disaster_type:oe_dis2_court_regency_crisis
		has_active_disaster = disaster_type:oe_dis2_industrial_labor_unrest
		has_active_disaster = disaster_type:oe_dis2_confessional_schism_backlash
	}
}

# Country scope. Era-lock sanity check for P21 probe: Age 5-6 disasters never active before 1640.
oe_dis2_age5_lock_ok = {
	OR = {
		current_year >= 1640
		AND = {
			NOT = { has_active_disaster = disaster_type:oe_dis2_colonial_independence_wave }
			NOT = { has_active_disaster = disaster_type:oe_dis2_industrial_labor_unrest }
		}
	}
}
